teacher_info.introduction: Hi there, my name is Libby and I can't wait to join you on your language learning adventures! I've taken classes at the high school and college level, in both the United States and abroad; I've received private tutoring; and I was selected by the Modern Languages Department of the College of William & Mary to serve as a French tutorffffffffffffff. And now that I've graduated college, I'm studying new languages on my own. So, no matter what your background in language is, I understand where you're coming from and I'm happy to adapt to your individual goals and learning style. If you are interested in learning French, I am experienced in teaching grammatical concepts to students of all levels, and my background in Latin and Old French (the French of the middle ages) means I have a unique perspective on etymology and historical French, if that's something that interests you. I know that learning a new language takes more than the few hours per week that we'll have together, so I want to help you build a comprehensive strategy, using whatever combination of traditional study tools, online resources, and immersion opportunities suits you. If you are interested in learning Ancient Greek, I'm ready with lessons on the alphabet, vocabulary, and multiple approaches to grammar. My broad familiarity with Indo-European languages has exposed me to many ways of explaining these sometimes confusing grammatical concepts. Once you've learned the basics, or if you're already comfortable with them, we can move on to translating genuine ancient texts together. The dialect that I learned is Attic (the language of Plato), but if you understand that dialect, it's very easy to move to Ionic (the language of Homer) and Koine (the language of the New Testament). Please let me know if you would prefer to talk through skype or google hangouts.

I graduated from Western Connecticut State University where I earned a bachelor's degree in English. In 2008 I moved to Chengdu and accepted a full time position teaching English for Southwestern University of Finance and Economics. Here I had new opportunities to develop my skills as a teacher. Over the years I have come to appreciate how important it is for the student to enjoy language learning and incorporate the target language into everyday life. Having said that, I don't really favor any one particular language teaching method or strategy. Each student is different and has different learning needs and preferences. One of the great things about one on one tutoring is the flexibility to tailor the lessons to the students individual needs. I look forward to working with you and helping you meet your language goals!

course_info.trial_description:
It usually feels very scary to book a first lesson. Maybe you have had bad experiences with English learning in the past. Perhaps it feels strange to meet a stranger on a computer. And of course - trying something new is always scary! And I'm a new person and learning English this way - may be a new thing for you! 

But please don't worry! You're not alone. Nearly EVERYONE feels this way. It was the same for me when I had my first online class. 

I will bring care and empathy to every lesson, and especially the first one. In the trial lesson, I won't be evaluating you. I will not correct your mistakes on our first call together. 

Instead - my intention is that you feel comfortable and relaxed. I want you to see what I am like as a teacher, and I want to get to know you! 

I know your abilities are better than they will appear in this first class, because you will probably be nervous. That's totally normal! We're humans! 

I will listen without judgement and offer a lot of empathy. I will let you speak. I will give you the opportunity to really be heard.

This will allow us to see if working together makes sense. If we decide to continue with another class, what you share in the trial lesson will help me design personalized classes for you - based on your interests, lifestyle needs, goals, strengths, and challenges. 

I hope this makes sense. If you don't understand anything, or if you have any questions - please message me!!!

I look forward to meeting you soon!

I understand! That's how I feel. I don't like talking about the weather or what I did yesterday or what I am going to do for vacation/holiday.

Instead, I like to hear what people really think, what they have experienced in their lives, and what they care about.

I give students the opportunity to talk about what they LIKE to talk about. Things that interest them. What they like to think and learn about. Their lives. Their world. 

Getting a chance to actually converse, in English, might be just what you're missing - and it can help build your confidence and increase your motivation.

My students are usually people who like to learn - and outside of class they enjoy learning about psychology, philosophy, personal growth, art, creativity, entrepreneurship, and many other things. 

In our classes, I provide a space for students to talk about these topics - to engage with the material they watch or listen to. To share what they're learning and what it means to them.

I usually come up with interesting subjects and initiate conversation. I will stop you to correct you at a level and frequency that you are comfortable with but I have a technique so as not to break up the flow of conversation.

Besides conversation, my specialties are 'business English', the IELTS and TOEFL exams, and casual/colloquial American English which includes slang and idioms. I also specialize in phrasal verbs.

I have a number of *fantastic* books in pdf form that I can share with you and that we can use in our lessons.

I have techniques to help with improving pronunciation.

I usually do not teach children younger than 16. Also if your level is below A2, please message me first.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation
pro_course_detail.description:
Let's chat in English. I can correct errors in grammar and pronunciation while you are talking. We will learn new vocabulary, idioms and expressions.  It is very easy for me to generate free-flowing conversation. 

If desired, we can also choose an article to strengthen your vocabulary and give us a subject matter. 

I can talk about anything but I'm particularly good at these topics: Travel; Rock, Rap and Electronica; Science; Philosophy; Food; Space; Gadgets/Technology; People/Culture; and Movies!

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation + Pronunciation Exercise
pro_course_detail.description:
Let's chat in English. I can correct errors in grammar and pronunciation while you are talking. We will learn new vocabulary, idioms and expressions.  It is very easy for me to generate free-flowing conversation. 

If desired, we can also choose an article to strengthen your vocabulary and give us a subject matter. 

As the student reads the article aloud, little by little I can modify the student's pronunciation into correct pronunciation. The next stage is to transfer the corrected pronunciation from article reading to actual conversation. Students have been reporting great progress with my 'pronunciation exercises'!

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation With Idioms, Slang, Phrasal Verbs
pro_course_detail.description: This is a conversation course where we focus on idioms, slang, and/or phrasal verbs. Although this course is designed to be beneficial to the advanced speaker, it can also be a useful approach to conversation for lower-level speakers.

pro_course_detail.title: History of Rock, Rap & Electronica - Let's Talk Music!
pro_course_detail.description:
I have studied the history of rock, rap and electronica and I am totally interested in a lot of genres. I thought that this would be a great topic for English conversation if people are interested. Let's have a conversation but talk about something related to rock, rap or electronica.

**Note that this lesson is only for people with a sincere interest or knowledge in certain genres or the history of music. It is not meant to be a discussion for people who are interested in commercial pop or with a superficial or minor interest in music. In that case, please sign up for my 'Conversation' lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: Market Leader English
pro_course_detail.description:
I have a set of books for all levels that I share with my students called 'Market Leader'. Common topics are finance, management, marketing, sales, business meetings, business communication, making presentations, and business social interaction.

One of the best aspects of the books is that they set up 'role play' situations where the student and I must act out some roles in business interaction, negotiation, bargaining for a sale, etc. The book also has a lot of interesting discussion topics and business articles which give us a lot of material for discussion. Lastly there are 'live situation' listening samples from people in business which cover a wide range of the different English accents and non-native European accents in English.
